title: Customize Multi-modal RAI Guardrails with Precedent-based predictions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's zero-shot and few-shot classification performance (measuring F1, precision, and recall) in detecting policy-violating visual content—specifically images containing hateful symbols, negative stereotypes, and identity-based harassment (e.g., anti-Semitic, anti-Muslim, and anti-Black imagery)—using the UnsafeBench dataset.
